caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, glass-sided structure reminiscent of a coffin or display case, decorated with blue, gray, and brown borders, as well as floral motifs in red and orange. Inside the glass enclosure, there is a human figure lying on a bed with white and blue sheets, with their head resting on a patterned pillow. The figure is drawn in a naturalistic style with shades of tan, orange, and blue, and the body appears to be wrapped or draped with fabric in similar colors. The sides and roof of the glass case are constructed with blue frames, interspersed with red floral designs. The base of the structure is embellished with a decorative floral pattern in shades of blue, red, brown, and white, and horizontal handles or supports extend from either end of the base, colored similarly to the rest of the case. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, providing contrast to the detailed structure and figure within it.
title: Bulto
